desc: The CMMG Resolute FOB chambered in 5.56 NATO is designed for shooters seeking a well-balanced rifle with modern features and reliable performance. Built for versatility, it features a 16.1-inch barrel that provides optimal accuracy and velocity while maintaining a maneuverable profile. The rifle’s optics-ready configuration ensures compatibility with a wide range of red dots, scopes, and other sighting systems, allowing shooters to tailor their setup to their specific needs.
